title: Reorder for Size
prompt:
The struct
 
```c
struct Blob { char tag; double weight; short qty; char flag; };
```
 
measures 24 bytes here. Implement `size_t packed_size(void)` returning what `sizeof` would be for the best reordering of the same members (largest-first). Define the reordered struct locally and return its `sizeof` — reasoning made executable.

tests.name: expected packed size
tests.hint: double(8) + short(2) + char(1) + char(1) + 4 tail padding = 16.

tests.name: arithmetic matches reality
tests.code:
struct Packed { double weight; short qty; char tag; char flag; };
CHECK_EQ((int)packed_size(), (int)sizeof(struct Packed));
tests.hint: Your function must measure a real struct with exactly the same member set.
